security_gateway_id.description: ID of the Security Gateway resource this belongs to.
security_gateway_id.rationale: Associating the application with a specific gateway ensures proper access control and routing.

application_id.description: User-settable Application resource ID. Must start with a letter, 4-63 characters, can contain /a-z-/ and end with a number or letter.
application_id.rationale: Used to uniquely identify the application within the Security Gateway.

endpoint_matchers.description: Endpoint matchers to define which hostnames and ports the application uses.
endpoint_matchers.rationale: Ensures only authorized application endpoints are accessible through the Security Gateway.

upstreams.description: Optional list of upstream resources to forward traffic to.
upstreams.rationale: Traffic must be routed securely and through approved upstream networks.

egress_policy.description: Routing policy to define allowed egress regions.
egress_policy.rationale: Traffic must stay within approved regions for compliance.

network.rationale: Only approved networks should be used for security reasons.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name for the application.
display_name.rationale: Helps admins identify the application in the UI.

logging_enabled.description: Enable logging for auditing and monitoring.
logging_enabled.rationale: Logging ensures application access can be monitored.

project.description: Project ID if different from provider default.
project.rationale: Allows associating the application with a specific project.
